legacy_noncausal_evaluation.leakage_mechanism: Contemporaneous unresolved holdout residuals included in rolling std and conformity pool at forecast origin.

strictly_causal_evaluation.causality_mechanism: Holdout residuals delayed by 168 hours; scale and conformity pool derived strictly from resolved outcomes.

epistemic_conclusion: Correcting temporal lookahead leakage reveals that strictly causal holdout coverage is 84.89% (95% CI: [73.14%, 93.14%]), compared to the leaked 92.36%. The difference reflects genuine out-of-sample adaptation lag during volatility expansions. The active model HAR-RS-DOW-v1.0 remains statistically valid and well-calibrated, but claims of 92.36% coverage are corrected.
